crop.selection_basis: fixed center crop before any model fit or prediction inspection; local RTX 2050 memory-limited diagnostic

evaluation.fixed_mask: valid pixels AND normal-input event-active pixels, computed before perturbations

config.event_representation: 2 polarity channels x 5 equal-duration bins, raw counts, no per-sample normalization
config.flow_target: official inverse_optical_flow.avg_method forward displacement in pixels per 40ms interval
config.protocol_boundary: diagnostic-only; not Genesis/V2E paired comparison, not formal training, no real data or checkpoint selection
config.purpose: small synthetic public-data positive control for STE-FlowNet input, label, and optimizer path
config.validity: upstream inverse disocclusion mask == 0, finite converted flow, and forward endpoint in bounds

source_patch.augmentation: unchanged: pixel-center normalized grid with align_corners=False
